clauses.title: Owner decision record names every field
requires:
Decision ID
Kind
Target and revision
Question
Options and trade-offs
Recommendation
Owner choice
Rationale
Validity and invalidation conditions
While an owner decision or owner action is pending, the state is `WAITING_FOR_OWNER`.

clauses.title: The pull-request owner decision record is whole and section-scoped
requires:
Decision ID
Kind
Target and revision
Question
Options and trade-offs
Recommendation
Owner choice
Rationale
Validity and invalidation conditions

clauses.title: Issue owner-decision scope remains Issue-specific
requires: The shared AC-DECISION triggers and pending state apply unchanged; this Issue root adds no trigger of its own.

clauses.title: PR owner-decision scope remains PR-specific
requires: The shared AC-DECISION triggers and pending state apply; this PR root additionally pauses on dangerous operations, and ship decisions.
